title: Validity of a conditional previous source
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers, let $ok$ be a Boolean, let $d\in\{0,1,2\}$, and let $j\in\mathbb N$. If $ok$ is true, suppose $1\leq\rho(r_Q)+d$. Then the source that is the previous-configuration source indexed by $(d,j)$ when $ok$ is true and the constant-false source otherwise is valid for $\rho$.
